'''{{W|Discord (software)|Discord}}''' ([https://discord.gg official website]) is a real-time chatting platform. The Avant-Garde Wiki officially operates and maintains a server as an additional service to its central operations on Miraheze.

==Join==

The Constructed Worlds Wiki's official Discord server is located '''[https://discord.gg/67ukxm9P here]'''. You must have a Discord account with a verified e-mail to join. Upon joining, you will be brought to a welcome channel where you may self-authenticate yourself if you have a registered account on Miraheze.

==Rules and ops==

A copy of the Discord's servers are available at [[Avant Garde Official:Discord/Rules|Discord/Rules]].

Users with sysop privileges on the wiki automatically have ops status on the Discord server, either as administrator or moderator.

==Verification==

To verify your Discord account, type <code>.auth</code> when you join and follow the instructions that are sent to you via direct message.

==Categories and channels==

===Administration===

*<code>#annoucement</code> – announcements regarding the server and updates on the wiki, as well as updates from other select servers

===General===

*<code>#main</code> – general discussion related to the Avant Garde official and its community, as well as off-topic discussion

===Misc===

*<code>#shitpost</code> – memes and shitposting content
*<code>#debates-and-politics</code> – politics and news discussion/debate
*<code>#wiki-hub - post the article related to AG Wiki
